{{Top|leg}}
A '''steam pipe''' was a type of [[Pipe/Legends|pipe]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Horzao Darr]], commander of the [[sky-dreadnaught]] ''[[Maxion]]'', owned a steam pipe that he kept tucked into his [[uniform]] tunic. He [[Smoking/Legends|smoked]] the pipe while listening to the information presented to him by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' who landed on his vessel while in search of a missing [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]].<ref name="TMOE">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Masters of Exocron|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>
